note: Standard metered nasal spray pumps deliver 50 to 100 uL per nostril.

units: fraction of dose reaching the olfactory region
note: The olfactory region is a small fraction of the nasal surface and is poorly reached by conventional sprays. Device work aims to raise this.

units: fraction of exposed cells productively transfected
note: In vivo non-viral transfection of nasal epithelium. Wide because it depends on formulation and on mucociliary clearance competing with uptake.

units: cells in the exposed olfactory epithelium
note: Human olfactory epithelium is roughly 2 to 10 cm2 with ~1e6 cells/cm2.

units: fraction of secreted peptide entering the CNS compartment
note: Peptide secreted at the epithelium partitions between systemic uptake and direct nose-to-brain routes. Highly uncertain.

units: fraction of CSF replaced per hour
note: CSF is replaced roughly 3 to 4 times daily.
Enkephalins are degraded within minutes, principally by neprilysin and aminopeptidase N.
Effect of the neprilysin siRNA arm. Neprilysin is one of two main enzymes, so even complete knockdown cannot give an unbounded increase.
Enkephalin potency at DOR. Spans the range reported across assay formats.

units: days of useful expression from one dose
note: Transient, non-integrating plasmid in a tissue that turns over.
